title: The Efficacy of Using Far Infrared Radiation to Manage Muscular Dystrophies
brief_summary: The muscular dystrophies (MD) are a group of more than 30 neuromuscular disorders that are characterized by progressive skeletal muscle weakness, defects in muscle proteins and the death of muscle cells and tissue. This study will investigate the use of far infrared radiation for managing muscular dystrophies.

* Persons with muscular dystrophies
